intro: Looking for your next escape? Munnar delivers: rolling tea estates in the Western Ghats. Here is everything you need to plan a trip.

sections.heading: Why visit Munnar
paragraphs: Munnar (Kerala) is known for its hills, nature and tea experiences. Overall it is mid-range — comfortable stays and good food without overspending.

sections.heading: Best time to go
paragraphs: The best time to visit is September to March.

sections.heading: How to get there
paragraphs: Kochi airport is about 4 hours away by road.

sections.heading: Insider tip
paragraphs: Combine Munnar with Alleppey and Kochi for a classic Kerala loop.

faq.q: When is the best time to visit Munnar?

faq.a: Kochi airport is about 4 hours away by road.

faq.q: Where should I stay in Munnar?
faq.a: Popular choices: Munnar town for convenience; Chithirapuram for tea-estate resorts; Pallivasal for valley views.
